issuer: the New Mexico Motor Vehicle Division (Taxation and Revenue Department)
note: The MVD's driver's license page (read 2026-10-30) gives $18 for a four-year licence ($34 for eight; the four-year one is held, with $15 more once for the DWI records check of drivers moving from another state, not held). Its learner's permit page says a teen gets a provisional licence from 15½ and must hold it 12 months before a regular licence, so a full licence is kept from 17 (16½ rounded up). The ID card page's content loads by script and gave no fee or term, so no card is held.

sources.title: New Mexico MVD, Driver's License
sources.said: The fee is $18.00 for a four-year license or $34.00 for an eight-year license.

sources.title: New Mexico MVD, Apply for a Learner's Permit
sources.said: Stage 2: Provisional License – To get a provisional license, a teen must be at least 15 ½ years old ... The 12-month minimum period for which an individual is required to hold a provisional license before obtaining a regular driver’s license
